headline: AWS A2A Protocol Paves Way for Interoperable Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AWS has launched the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol to enable the creation of interoperable multi-agent systems, addressing the need for composable AI agents in various industries. This move is gaining significant attention as it could reshape how AI agents are deployed and integrated.
whyItMatters: It opens up new possibilities for AI interoperability, potentially reducing fragmentation and increasing the efficiency of AI deployments across different sectors.
